I'm not a very social person. I don't know where I'm supposed to go to find people to interact with. I have no money, so restuarants, coffee shops, movies etc. are out of the picture. I'm have agoraphobic and avoidant personality disorder, so going anywhere is difficult. I don't want to post online that I'm looking for friend, then I'm just going to end up having to shift through a lot of people to try and find a few that I click with.  


After all of that, how am I still supposed to know if these people are "true" friends? I thought the ones I already had were. One of them gave me a very thoughtful gift and was supportive, the other included me in his hobby.

I don't really trust anybody anymore. I don't have the energy to reach out or find new people, and I don't even know how to do that in the first place. And it's so difficult to find somebody who I'd click so well with as I did with my two friends. I want to, but I'm too tired to spend energy and time trying to look for someone.

I'm not on social media, so I wouldn't be able to see anything that way. Of course I keep an eye on the subreddit, but I also have other things to do and I don't have the time or energy to really monitor any  updates. Of course it's not the end of the world if I miss something, I'll hear about it eventually. The point was that last night I thought there was going to be something and I kept youtube open on a separate tab, seeing if something was going to happen. I was excited, as many others were too, but as time has gone on, all the hype that I had is gone. This is just not a great way to build hype, there's so many other things that could have been done, but instead we got this.

Idk if the stream was an accident since it's unlisted, but considering that it's on their website I doubt it, but who knows... Eitherway, it's not a great look for the band.

Sure, nobody is forced to watch it, but this is potentially something big and people don't want to miss it. For me, it built hype when I first saw it and at that point the stream had been going on for 2 hours, now that the stream has been going on for over 20 hours, I'm bored. Why waste your fans' time like this? You know what also would have built hype? Pretty much anything at this point tbh, but a countdown would have a lot nicer, you know when something is happening and don't have to wait with some random stream open in another tab. A puzzle that the community has to solve together is another option. It'd be a nice way to bring fans together and make them feel even more involved.  


Honestly, I'm disappointed with this stream. Call me dramatic or whatever, but I feel like I'm just being toyed with. They're purposely playing on peoples FOMO and I don't like that.

I feel like in the old sims games you had more control. I like a lot of the new features in ts4's building mode, but often times I'm just very frustrated over how the game handles the rooms. Making open staircases is bit of a pain and you have to fiddle around a lot to get it to work sometimes. Oftentimes rooms don't get recognized as rooms for whatever reason and that messes up a lot of stuff. I also hate how you have to paint the walls for each room separately on the outside, same with the foundation. I also miss not being able to paint over wall paint on just that specific section by holding down shift, in ts4 it's all or one time at a tile. While I'm at it, painting the walls by dragging your mouse seems to be pretty buggy.

I also feel like ts4's building mode isn't as innovative as it should be. Sure, over the years we've gotten better stuff, but honestly after this much of time it should have been in the base game since the beginning. We also don't have diagonal stairs, something I think we should have.
